# Test Fixtures

Test Makefile for validating `mkx` behavior.

## Available Targets

| Target | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| hello | Print a greeting |
| prompt | Ask for user input |
| long-running | Simulate a long task (5s) |
| fail | Always exits with error |
| multiline | Print lots of output |
| greet | Greet someone (pass NAME=) |
| confirm | Ask for confirmation |

## Usage

Run `mkx` from the `mkx/` directory — `testdata` will appear as a project.
